name: Haste
summary: Doubles a creature's Speed, adds +2 to its AC, and grants it an extra action each turn.

stats.effect:
Choose a willing creature that you can see within range. Until the spell ends, the target's {ref:glossary/speed} is doubled, it gains a +2 bonus to {ref:glossary/armor-class}, it has {ref:glossary/advantage} on Dexterity saving throws, and it gains an additional action on each of its turns. That action can be used to take only the {ref:glossary/attack} (one attack only), {ref:glossary/dash}, {ref:glossary/disengage}, {ref:glossary/hide}, or {ref:glossary/utilize} action.

When the spell ends, the target is {ref:condition/incapacitated} and has a Speed of 0 until the end of its next turn, as a wave of lethargy washes over it.
